notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Official Version Update v1.0.092701
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/p][p]Since the official launch, we've been truly grateful for your immense support and valuable feedback. We are also aware that some of you have encountered issues while playing. To ensure a smoother and more enjoyable experience, our team has been working hard on fixes. You can now update your game and continue your adventure.[/p][p][/p][p][b]▼ Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p]・Fixed an issue in the quest “The Food Festival Begins!” where some players entered the regular Blackjack Plaza instead of the festival version, causing NPCs to not appear or be interactable. An urgent fix has been applied — if you experienced this issue, please use the Q shortcut to return to your island and re-enter Blackjack Plaza. The quest should now proceed normally.[/p][p][/p][p]We're always committed to providing every adventurer with the best experience possible. Thank you once again for your support and feedback! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to reach out through our official channels. Wishing you a wonderful journey ahead![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Full Release Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Adventurers,[/p][p]Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous v1.0 is officially live, and we're thrilled to invite you all to jump in and experience the full release.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3148160/Dragon_Song_Tavern_Cozy__Adventurous/"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="2Zxq8DmUfKM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Alongside the release, we're also launching two brand-new DLCs: “Breeze of the Sea” DLC and Detective Outfit DLC. Don't miss them if you're interested![/p][p] [/p][p]“Breeze of the Sea” DLC:[/p][p]1. DST Official Artbook: Implemented as a special in-game item, allowing you to browse the artwork directly in-game.[/p][p]2. “Breeze of the Sea” DLC includes:[/p][p]New themed Furniture Set[/p][p]New themed Outfits[/p][p]New themed Pet[/p][p]New themed Ship Cosmetic[/p][p] [/p][p]DLC Price: $7.99[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4010300/Dragon_Song_Tavern_Cozy__Adventurous_Breeze_of_the_SeaDLC/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Detective Outfit DLC:[/p][p]Character Outfit Set: Detective Outfits[/p][p] [/p][p]DLC Price: $3.99[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4010390/Dragon_Song_Tavern_Cozy__Adventurous_Detective_Outfit_DLC/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]To celebrate the full release, we're offering a 20% launch discount for 14 days. Adventurers interested are welcome to purchase and play![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/af49926ad8675a035719d00b3c04df78dda90f24.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that's not all. As a token of our gratitude for your amazing support and to celebrate our attendance at TGS 2025 (Tokyo Game Show), we're giving away a free character outfit set, Pajama Party, to all players![/p][p]Gift Code: TGS2025[/p][p](See the picture below for instructions on how to redeem.)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/b3b37757f7e06718bb3dc699546ef9993878a50b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks again to all the adventurers who supported us during Early Access. We also warmly welcome all newcomers joining us now. We hope you enjoy all the new content we've carefully prepared for the full release.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you encounter any issues in-game or have suggestions, here's how you can reach us:[/p][p]1. Click the \[BUG] icon in-game to report issues.[/p][p]2. Join our official Discord to chat with us and report problems.[/p][p]Discord:[url="https://discord.gg/JrJjFuCZtk"]Dragon Song Tavern[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You can also follow our official channels for more updates and news:[/p][p]X:[url="https:////x.com/DST_EN"]@DST_EN[/url][/p][p]Instagram:[url="https://www.instagram.com/dragonsongtavern_en/"]@dragonsongtavern_en[/url][/p][p]YouTube:[url="https://www.youtube.com/@DST_EN"]@DST_EN[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to every player who has supported and loved Dragon Song Tavern![/p][p] [/p][p]The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Full Release v1.0 Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/bb94eae4879f05aad3607e7c5707a24b025e2c86.jpg"][/img][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]After months in Early Access, we’re excited to announce that Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous will officially launch with its Full Release v1.0 on September 24th at 12 p.m. (EDT)! To celebrate, we’ll also be offering a 20% launch discount from Sept 24, 12 p.m. (EDT) to Oct 8, 12 p.m. (EDT). We hope you’ll take this opportunity to recommend our game to your friends.[/p][p][/p][p]The v1.0 update introduces the continuation of the main storyline, the long-awaited eighth map Phantom’s Veil, new monsters, forageables, recipes, and most importantly individual bedroom decoration, a feature many of you have been eagerly waiting for.[/p][p] [/p][p]Update Highlights:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/be623e1f5607c7e83a43cb61c286c89144e62da2.png"][/img][/p][p]Overview: A mysterious guest arrives late at night... a commission to help with a festival... but behind the joy of a grand carnival lies an unexpected conspiracy. As the adventure deepens, Gracie and Elio must make a crucial decision, and your choices will shape the future of the tavern.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/f6f04588e3149547a3908f06c7850445dd466a15.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/066106eeb0ae9e6e169a78a29480da2f6676028a.png"][/img][/p][p]On the night of the full moon, a passage through the Mist opens for just one hour, leading to an island long lost to history. Strange and dangerous monsters roam here, dropping unique materials that can be used in recipes. Prepare carefully before stepping onto this mysterious island.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/7f41f3b66198f8af0555c73d645563fd64cad0fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/4a66808b662046625b1863293e7a2d8e245f9b5b.png"][/img][/p][p]   (1) \[Dungeon Stew]: Research this recipe using drops from Phantom’s Veil monsters and cook a hearty dish.[/p][p]   (2) \[Twilight Dreameade]: Unlock this refreshing drink recipe with drops from Phantom’s Veil monsters.[/p][p]   (3) \[Moonlitch Wine]: Brew this special drink recipe using drops from Phantom’s Veil monsters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/78548fcecddb0c1789125f9044036c11c2e46509.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/56d2b75c39ed5bd3023c95c91d73d7a3276c015c.png"][/img][/p][p]Cute companions are here! In the full release, adventurers will be able to have pets that follow them around. Beyond simply keeping you company, these adorable pets also bring added convenience during your adventures. (For details on their functions, please discover them yourself in the full release!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/3637b5b6a4d3e7926bebad1f8aaecbfc458ba62a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/c56d16c7c0ababf5072b9dafcf306b6eb297f542.png"][/img][/p][p]At last, your own cozy retreat! With the full release, adventurers will finally have access to personal bedrooms. Head upstairs from the kitchen to the tavern’s second floor and step into your private space. Here, you can not only take a well-deserved rest after a long day but also decorate the room to your liking and create a bedroom that truly feels like home.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/72bf9b64f5dbc1dd1c0c4e472894533f3bdd886a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Free Deluxe Edition Upgrade:[/p][p]As a token of our gratitude for your early support, all players who purchased the game during Early Access will receive a free upgrade to the Deluxe Edition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/604a19207e41f963b8751c413e745606a64e4b78.jpg"][/img]How it works:[/p][p]All existing players who purchased the base game will automatically be upgraded to the Deluxe Edition before the full release. The Deluxe Edition will officially unlock on September 24th at 12 p.m. (EDT) for all players.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t purchased the game yet, don’t worry! Anyone who buys the game before September 24th at 12 p.m. (EDT) will also enjoy a free upgrade to the Deluxe Edition.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: After the full release goes live, the Deluxe Edition will only be available as a paid option in the store and will no longer be offered as a free upgrade. If you’d like to secure the Deluxe Edition for free, please make sure to grab the game before the release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/6dc504b811410975cff4bef759227dfadf925593.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Co-op Mode[/b][/p][p]Thanks to the team’s hard work and Luka’s diligent supervision, the Co-op Mode is finally here! You can now team up with friends to build and manage your own island together![/p][p] [/p][p]Co-op Mode Features:[/p][p] [/p][p]Experience the joy of running a tavern together![/p][p]You fight, I farm, double the resources, no time wasted![/p][p]You serve, I cash out, double the efficiency, business is thriving![/p][p][/p][p][b]New DLC Content[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to bring two new DLCs alongside the release:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Deluxe Edition DLC:[/b][/p][p]1.DST Official Artbook: Implemented as a special in-game item, allowing you to browse the artwork directly in-game.[/p][p] [/p][p]2.“Breeze of the Sea” DLC:[/p][p]New themed Furniture Set[/p][p]New themed Outfits[/p][p]New themed Pet[/p][p]New themed Ship Cosmetic[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/65e92019a1a1c73867b82918b53519f082cbfca9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Character Outfit DLC:[/b][/p][p]Detective Outfits[/p][p]Additional Themed Outfits[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/c5de53c197a60e59d76b21139eb2b823b369a59e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That wraps up the contents of the Full Release v1.0 update! We’d like to sincerely thank all the adventurers who supported us during Early Access. We can’t wait for you to dive into the full release and enjoy everything we’ve prepared with care.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you again for all your love and support![/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Dev Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous — Full Release Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]This is the dev team of Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous, and today we’re thrilled to share some exciting news![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Our game will be leaving Early Access and officially launching on September 24th EDT![/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Over the past three months of Early Access, we’ve received so much love, feedback, and support from all of you. Thanks to that, we’ve made countless optimizations and updates to improve our game, all of which will be included in the full release. We hope you enjoy it![/p][p] [/p][p]The full release will feature brand new maps, gameplay modes, storylines, and much more. Alongside the launch, we’ll also be releasing the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b], which includes:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]-DST Official Artbook:[/b] Implemented as a special in-game item, allowing you to browse the artwork directly in-game.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]-“Breeze of the Sea” DLC:[/b][/p][p]-New Furniture Set[/p][p]-New Outfits[/p][p]-New Pet[/p][p]-New Ship Cosmetic[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146743/4bed8122d766759b0c5ed9b45dc880837b515629.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have also prepared a special gift for the players who have supported us from the start. We know this journey from Early Access to the full release wouldn’t have been possible without your support. [b]As a token of gratitude, every player who purchased the game during Early Access will be upgraded to the Deluxe Edition for free![/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]How it works:[/b][/p][p]All existing players who purchased the base game will automatically be upgraded to the Deluxe Edition before the full release.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Deluxe Edition content will officially unlock on September 24th at 12:00 EDT along with the full release.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]If you haven’t purchased the game yet, don’t worry! Anyone who buys the game before September 24th at 12:00 (EDT) will also enjoy a free upgrade to the Deluxe Edition.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Notice:[/b] After the official release, the Deluxe Edition will be available as a separate purchase in the store, and the free upgrade offer will end. If you’d like to secure your Deluxe upgrade for free, make sure to grab the base game before official launch![/p][p] [/p][p]With just two weeks left until the full release, we’ll be working tirelessly to polish every detail and deliver the best experience to all of you who love our game![/p][p] [/p][p]Sincere gratitude to every single player for your love and support.[/p][p] [/p][p]Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Dev Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Early Access-Summer Major Content Update
notes.notes: [p]Adventurers! Exciting news: The v0.2.070201 Summer Update for Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous is now live! notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous – Early Access Update Notice v0.2.060501
notes.notes:
Since launching in Early Access, we've been thrilled by your love for the game and grateful for all your feedback and reports. To ensure a smoother adventure for everyone, we've addressed several issues based on your experiences.

▼ New Game Content
・Added the side quest "The Dwarves' Approval." Completion unlocks a new premium wine recipe collection item.
・The Magic Oddities Shop now offers Power Rune exchange for other runes.

▼ Game Issue Fixes
・Fixed incorrect recipe tier display for Sago Pudding. Adventurers can now properly research Tier 3 recipes.
・Fixed misleading maturity time descriptions for Golden Rice Seeds.
・Fixed missing guidance icons on adventure map tasks.
・Fixed missing quest item drops after defeating Horned Dragons.
・Fixed Murlocs being incorrectly described as wild boars in adventure quests.
・Fixed unrecovered quest items in the "Debt Collection" mission chain.
・Fixed incorrect yield display for milk and egg harvesting.
・Fixed abnormal fruit tree duplication and unharvestable state issues.
・Fixed fishing failures when using Summon Fish School during winter.
・Fixed abnormal mini-game mechanics for red grape juice production. Reduced material costs and increased sale price.

▼ Other Gameplay Optimizations
・Implemented ultrawide screen support and optimization.
・Improved UI layout for Japanese text localization.
・Restored date displays in announcements and save files.
・Completely rebalanced fish spawning seasons. Added Shrimp, Blue Crab, and Blue Lobster as rare catches.
・Optimized Fried Fish Fillet premium recipe descriptions and materials. Rarer materials now exclusively appear in Tier 3 recipes.
・Reduced barrel requirements for Level 6 taverns. Now only requires 2 barrels per wine type.

We remain committed to providing the best possible experience for our adventurers. Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out through our official channels. Enjoy your adventure!

The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team

・Fixed game crash when Rogues used the skill [Shadow Dance]

・Fixed random crashes during special fishing spot activities
・Fixed abnormal fruit growth on trees during summer

・Dairy Workshop and Meat Workshop processing times have been significantly reduced

notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

Since launching in Early Access, we've been thrilled by your love for the game and grateful for all your feedback and reports. To ensure a smoother adventure for everyone, we've addressed several issues based on your experiences.

▼Game Performance Fixes
・Fixed an issue causing game freezes after certain skill casts.
・Fixed an issue where enemies hit by Slow could become unresponsive.

▼Other Fixes
・Fixed missing available quest markers on NPCs.
・Fixed map display errors for quest objectives.

▼ Gameplay Improvements
▶ Material Gathering
・Fishing Revamp: Wild fishing spots now exclusively yield Tier 3 or higher rarity fish.
・Tier 3 Fish Boost: Spawn rates for Tier 3 fish tripled on home islands and in towns.

▶ Crafting Optimization
Brewing:
・Ingredient costs for all brewing reduced by over 60%.
・Adjusted production times for Vodka, White Wine, and Red Wine.
Large Fish Processing:
・Material yield from large fish doubled.
Legendary Fish Cooking:
・Food output from legendary fish doubled.

▶ Shop Updates
・Fish Shop: Now sells Conch & Seabass (replaced low-tier fish).
・Butcher Shop: Meat restocks daily (was weekly), and doubled the weekly purchase limit on meat items.

▶Combat Rewards Update
・Open-world battle rewards have been significantly increased:
・Regular Monsters: Drop quantity now scales with monster count (3-5 ingredients, up from 1-2).
・Rare Elites: Guaranteed drops increased from 4 to 6 items.
・Bosses: Total drop value boosted by 50%.

▶Crafting QoL Adjustments
Reduced grind in production systems:
・Double Yield Skill (Farming)・Unlock tiers reduced: 100/200/300 crops (down from 150/300/600).
・Juicing Minigame: Duration shortened by 30% and score thresholds lowered for high-tier rewards.

We remain committed to providing the best possible experience for our adventurers. Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out through our official channels. Enjoy your adventure!

The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team

Greetings Adventurers!

Since launching in Early Access, we've been thrilled by your love for the game and grateful for all your feedback and reports. To ensure a smoother adventure for everyone, we've addressed several issues based on your experiences.

▼ Game Performance Fixes:
・Fixed a crash issue that occurred when running in the background or taking screenshots, caused by an audio plugin.
・Fixed an issue where loaded saves would not retain the selected resolution setting.
・Fixed an issue causing the game to freeze after returning to battle from the Load menu during combat.
・Fixed an issue causing the game to freeze when switching maps or loading a save.

▼ Other Bug Fixes:
・Fixed an issue preventing the Customer Preferences Catalog from displaying correctly.
・Fixed incorrect rewards for the Food Festival quest.
・Fixed an issue where players could occasionally freeze while juicing or fishing.
・Fixed an issue preventing the Red Dragon's Breath Phoenix from respawning correctly.
・Fixed missing localized text translations for certain quest chains.
・Fixed an issue preventing the Swordfish Roll recipe research from triggering correctly; obtaining Swordfish Meat will now trigger it as intended.

▼ Gameplay Improvements:
・Adjusted the time flow rate: Game time now passes twice as fast (changed from 12x real-time speed to 24x real-time speed).
・Updated the nighttime visuals for the island.
・Increased the drop quantity from common wild monsters.
・Enlarged the Customer Diary button for better visibility.

We remain committed to providing the best possible experience for our adventurers. Thank you for your continued support and feedback! If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please reach out through our official channels. Happy adventuring!

The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team

notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous - Early Access Patch Notes V0.2.053001
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers!

Since the game launched in Early Access, we have received much love and suggestions for our game from many adventurers, along with numerous issues encountered during gameplay. To ensure a better gaming experience for all adventurers, we have fixed these issues.

▼ Quest-Related Issues:
・Fixed the issue where 'Challenging Adventurers' quest could not be completed. Quests of this type that have already been accepted will be removed from the quest log.
・Fixed the issue where loading a save after starting the 'Luminous Honey Mead' quest would prevent the quest from triggering.
・Fixed 'Debt Collection' quest NPC not appearing
・Fixed 'Giant Treant Leaves' quest item not dropping

▼ Achievement-Related Issues:
・Resolved the issue where achievements could not be completed. Achievements previously completed will be retroactively awarded based on save data.

▼ Other Bug Fixes:
・Fixed an issue where fishing could sometimes cause the game to freeze.
・Fixed an issue where battles could occasionally cause the game to freeze.
・Corrected some instances of missing translations.

We remain committed to providing a better gaming experience for all adventurers. Thank you for your support and feedback! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us through official channels. Enjoy your adventure!

The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team

notes.title: February 25th Update
notes.notes:
On the first day of Next Fest, we released a major update version, which received a lot of positive feedback. The Demo download numbers and wish list data on Steam have been incredible. At the same time, we received a lot of bug reports, so we’ve worked quickly to address some of these issues and released this update. Here are the details of the update:

●Battle freezing issue fixed, improving the smoothness of combat.
●Seat placement issue fixed, ensuring a more comfortable experience for players.
●Parsley time issue fixed, ensuring the time settings are correct.
●Tavern information interface optimized, enhancing the visual experience.
●Tailor shop tip updated in the fashion interface.
●Cherry wine recipe bug fixed, the recipe can now be learned.
●Return item quest dialogue bug fixed.
●Rare gathering in Dark Cave bug fixed.
●Weapon disappearing bug fixed, ensuring weapons will not disappear.
●Stamina limit not saving after reloading bug fixed, improving gameplay experience.
●0 stamina still being able to water plants bug fixed.
●Weapon official icons added, enhancing the visual appeal.
●Loot quest task optimization, preventing it from overwriting existing tasks.
●Shop scene detail optimization, improving visual and operational experience.
●Collection description reading configuration optimized, ensuring accurate descriptions.
●New drinking action added, providing more interactive experiences.
●New indoor footstep sounds in shops, enhancing the immersive atmosphere.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope you enjoy the new version and wish you a great gaming experience!

notes.title: Next Fest update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Adventures,[/h2]
It's been less than a month since our game demo was launched, and we've already received over 10,000 downloads worldwide! For our small indie game studio, this is absolutely amazing! We're deeply moved by your love for the game and the valuable feedback you've provided. We sincerely thank each one of you for your support! We've participated in this year's February Next Fest, and to celebrate this special occasion, we've prepared a major update. Let's check out all the fresh and exciting content in this update! ✨

[h3]🎮 Gamepad Support is Here![/h3]
That's right, gamepad support is finally here! Grab your gamepad, sit back on the comfy couch, and enjoy a smoother gaming experience!
[h3]⏳ Extended Game Duration[/h3]
Based on your feedback, we've decided to extend the game's time limit from 12 days to 24 days! Now you'll have more time to explore, adventure, and fully enjoy the game's fun!
[h3]🌴 New Adventure Map – Fernland[/h3]
Wow! The brand new adventure map – Fernland – is now live! Explore this mysterious island, discover new ingredients, and create your own unique recipes to show off at the tavern!
[h3]🛍 Major Overhaul of the Town Shop[/h3]
We've given the town shop a major upgrade! The shop now has even more new resources, and the tailor shop has added dozens of new outfits. Go pick one out for yourself and become the trendiest resident of the town!
[h3]🎶 Audio Upgrade[/h3]
This update brings a major improvement to the sound effects! You'll now hear richer sound effects and brand new original music that will totally immerse you in the experience!
[h3]🌱 Improved Farming Experience[/h3]
The farming animations are now much smoother! Plus, we've added magical items that allow you to take care of up to 9 plots of land at once, saving you time and effort. Become an efficient farming pro!
[h3]📚 New Encyclopedia System[/h3]
Look! The brand new Encyclopedia System is live! You can now track your collection progress and unlock trophies. These trophies will give you double rewards while farming, fishing, and gathering!
[h3]😄 Other Optimizations[/h3]
We've also made some minor optimizations to enhance the overall gaming experience, ensuring that every player can enjoy the game smoothly!
[h3]🎉 Bug Fixes[/h3]
We've fixed almost 30 bugs, and now the game is more stable and smoother than ever. Enjoy playing with no interruptions!

Finally, if you like our game, don't forget to add it to your wishlist! The wishlist is super important for us to get support from Steam! 💖
Dragon Song Tavern Team
